title: slides
description: Slides to show one at a time, each as tall as the screen: a cover of the title, then slides of a heading over parts, a slide of a heading alone standing between parts of the talk.

subtitle.description: A line under the title on the cover, such as who speaks and when; a line of Markdown

parts.description: The parts of the slide, as report's; left out, the slide is a heading alone, between parts of the talk
